data.text: Kate, I’ll join you. I commit to catch 15 tons today and donate the $15,000 proceeds to the clinic. I also commit to no more than six tons next month under our shared 30-ton recovery limit. My family taught me to look after both the lake and the people who depend on it; this exception needs that recovery commitment from all five of us. Emma, will you commit to the donation and next month’s limit too?
